campaigns.title: Singapore reports a rise in first-half 2026 e-commerce scams
campaigns.summary: ScamShield's official situation report records 3,865 e-commerce scam cases and S$8.3 million in reported losses in the first half of 2026. Pre-order scams involving Pokémon trading cards were a prominent trend. Verify sellers, listings, and payment routes independently before paying.

campaigns.title: FBI warns that scammers are impersonating the Internet Crime Complaint Center
campaigns.summary: The FBI says criminals are targeting previous fraud victims while impersonating IC3 or FBI personnel. Reported tactics include recovery promises, AI-generated videos, spoofed websites, urgency, and requests for money or personal information. IC3 does not contact people through social media or offer fund-recovery services.

campaigns.title: FBI warns about redirects to fraudulent websites
campaigns.summary: The FBI warns that criminal traffic-distribution systems can route people from phishing messages, poisoned search results, advertisements, or compromised websites to fake login pages and malicious downloads. A familiar starting page does not guarantee the final destination is trustworthy.

campaigns.title: FTC warns about fake employee IDs sent by text
campaigns.summary: The FTC warns that impostors may claim they can recover scam losses and send a fake employee ID or badge to build trust. A real FTC employee will not contact you by text or messaging app to offer recovery, direct you to move money, or request financial information.
